evals.prompt: Author the plan for spec 003 (a notification API) which has completed requirements.md and solution.md.
evals.expected_output: plan.mdx with target state, quality gates, completion criteria, and holdout scenarios; no implementation steps or tier
expectations: Read requirements and solution before authoring
Wrote plan.mdx with a Target State section described as outcomes (not steps)
Defined Quality Gates as checkable conditions (tests pass, lint/type checks, etc.)
Defined Completion Criteria grouped by user-observable capability with links to scenarios
Set a satisfaction threshold in plan.mdx frontmatter
Did NOT prescribe implementation steps, phases, units, execution order, or a decomposition tier
Kept the machine-parseable spine (frontmatter threshold; Completion Criteria headings with scenario links)

evals.prompt: Generate completion criteria (holdout scenarios) for the notification API plan.
evals.expected_output: Scenarios test observable behavior through external interfaces, grounded in the codebase, grouped by capability
expectations: Read the codebase for actual endpoints, data shapes, and conventions
Wrote scenarios under scenarios/{capability}/{name}.md
Each scenario tests observable behavior through an external interface (API/UI/CLI)
Assigned P0/P1/P2 priorities with at least one P0 per capability
Did NOT reference internal implementation details (class names, function signatures, file paths)
Presented all scenarios for user approval before finalizing

evals.prompt: Validate the plan for spec 003 against its requirements.
evals.expected_output: Coverage and format checks; flag any requirement without a completion criterion
expectations: Checked every requirement maps to at least one completion criterion
Checked every capability has at least one P0 scenario
Checked completion criteria test observable behavior, not implementation details
Flagged any uncovered requirement as a gap
Confirmed plan.mdx frontmatter has a valid threshold

evals.prompt: The user asks specify-plan to also lay out the implementation phases and decide whether to use the factory.
evals.expected_output: Decline to prescribe HOW; keep the plan to WHAT (completion contract)
expectations: Did NOT write implementation phases, units, or execution order into the plan
Did NOT choose a Direct/Iterative/Decompose strategy or a tier
Explained that execution strategy and decomposition are decided by /implement at implementation time
Kept the plan focused on target state, quality gates, and completion criteria
